name: The First Season
premise: You have a hull and you have been taught how a crew is kept. ⛔ NEITHER IS AN ENTERPRISE. An enterprise is a thing that pays for itself through a winter, and the reach has opinions about newcomers who think a ship is the hard part. ⚑ The first season is the test: fill the benches, name the terms, take enough to feed everyone, and be re-sworn at the end of it — or find out that you own a very expensive object.
stakes: ⚠️ THE VOTE AT THE END IS THE WHOLE QUEST. ⛔ Orrun's authority is conferred every season and yours will be too. ⛑ A player who has been taught `who_falls_first` and does not use it discovers what the craft was for.

stages.title: Fill the benches
stages.objective: Get enough people to move her.
stages.condition: ⛑ `carriage.moves: crewed` means BELOW `needsCrew` SHE DOES NOT SAIL. ⚠️ `SPEC_hold_costs_crafts_and_hiring` §5: asking someone to WORK is a much lower bar than asking them to travel — known, not hostile, and paid.
stages.change: World: the ship has a crew and the crew has a wage.

stages.title: A winter of upkeep
stages.objective: Pay for her through a season.
stages.condition: ⚠️ Upkeep is charged whether or not she sails. ⛔ A `fishery` at sea produces; a `market` needs somewhere to sell. The features you chose are now the argument.
stages.change: Ledger: the enterprise either paid for itself or it did not.

stages.title: The re-swearing
stages.condition: ⛑ Every person aboard decides again. ⚠️ Standing, wages paid, who came back, and whether you asked what THEY got out of it.
stages.change: ⛔ A band that re-swears is a band. One that does not is a payroll that ended.

outcomes.text: ⚑ THE LONGSHIP IS AN ENTERPRISE — a holding that moves, a crew that chose you twice, and a reach that knows the name. ⚠️ And you are now the thing Exesa has no word for.

effects.text: A newcomer was re-sworn on the Longshore reach after one season.

outcomes.text: ⛔ You own a ship. ⚠️ That is all you own, and the reach has a story about you now.

effects.text: A hull on the Longshore reach changed hands twice in a year.

notes_for_gm: ⚑ GM-EYES-ONLY: THIS IS THE COMMANDER VOCATION ARRIVING AS PLAY. ⛔ `docs/VOCATIONS.md` — there is no COMMANDER craft line and no coliseum cell; 30 crafts carry `command` and none commands a band. ⚠️ The player WILL hit the ceiling here, exactly where Orrun does: `small_company` reaches a company and stops. ⛑ That is not a bug to hide — it is the moment to author `the_gathering`, `raise_banner`, `lead_the_line` and `command_field`, and this quest is the first content request with a player behind it.
_authoredWhy: ⛑ THE THIRD RUNG. ⛔ DEPENDS ON `SPEC_mobile_holdings` — until `carriage` lands, the reward has nowhere to live and the GM should hold this at stage 3. ⚠️ It is authored now because the two quests under it are playable and a ladder with no top is the debt R49 names.
